token = apis.spotify.login(username='andrew_brow@gmail.com', password=[x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0])['access_token']

page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
all_playlists = []
all_song_ids = set()

while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    # API may return list directly
    if not page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    for pl in page:
        for sid in pl.get('song_ids', []) or []:
            all_song_ids.add(sid)
    print('page', page_index, 'playlists', len(page), 'unique_song_ids_so_far', len(all_song_ids))
    page_index += 1
    if page_index > 200:
        break

print('total_playlists', len(all_playlists))
print('total_unique_song_ids', len(all_song_ids))
print('sample_playlist_titles', [p['title'] for p in all_playlists[:5]])

token = apis.spotify.login(username='andrew_brow@gmail.com', password=[x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0])['access_token']

# Collect song ids from playlist library only ("my playlists")
page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
song_ids=set()
playlists=[]

while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    playlists.extend(page)
    for pl in page:
        for sid in pl.get('song_ids', []) or []:
            song_ids.add(sid)
    print('playlist_library page', page_index, 'playlists_in_page', len(page), 'unique_song_ids_so_far', len(song_ids))
    page_index += 1
    if page_index>200:
        break

print('total_playlists_in_library', len(playlists))
print('total_unique_song_ids_in_playlists', len(song_ids))

# Inspect genres to see how reggae appears
song_id_list = sorted(song_ids)
probe_ids = song_id_list[:15]
print('probe_song_ids', probe_ids)
for sid in probe_ids:
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    print('sid', sid, 'title', s.get('title'), 'genre', s.get('genre'), 'artist_names', [a.get('name') for a in s.get('artists', [])])

# Filter reggae songs by song.genre
reggae_song_ids=[]
for sid in song_id_list:
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre = (s.get('genre') or '')
    if genre.lower()=='reggae':
        reggae_song_ids.append(sid)

print('reggae_song_ids_count', len(reggae_song_ids))
print('reggae_song_ids_sample', reggae_song_ids[:20])

token = apis.spotify.login(username='andrew_brow@gmail.com', password=[x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0])['access_token']

# Recompute reggae songs from my playlists (playlist library) and collect reggae song ids
page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
song_ids=set()

playlists=[]
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    playlists.extend(page)
    for pl in page:
        for sid in pl.get('song_ids', []) or []:
            song_ids.add(sid)
    page_index += 1
    if page_index>200:
        break

reggae_song_ids=[]
for sid in sorted(song_ids):
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre = (s.get('genre') or '').lower()
    if genre == 'reggae':
        reggae_song_ids.append(sid)

print('my_playlists_count', len(playlists))
print('unique_songs_in_my_playlists', len(song_ids))
print('reggae_song_ids_count', len(reggae_song_ids))
print('reggae_song_ids', reggae_song_ids)

# Collect unique artists from these reggae songs
artist_id_to_name = {}
for sid in reggae_song_ids:
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    print('reggae_song', sid, s.get('title'), 'artists', [a.get('name') for a in s.get('artists', [])])
    for a in s.get('artists', []) or []:
        artist_id_to_name[a.get('id')] = a.get('name')

print('unique_reggae_artists_count', len(artist_id_to_name))
print('unique_reggae_artist_ids', sorted(artist_id_to_name.keys()))
print('unique_reggae_artist_names', [artist_id_to_name[i] for i in sorted(artist_id_to_name.keys())])
